title: What If Asta Remembered Everything? Part 1

ASTA.description: Sharp, quiet, strategic. An old soul in a child's body, dry humour, never screechy.

LIEBE.description: Raspy, sarcastic, guarded devil sealed in the five-leaf grimoire.

YAMI.description: Gravelly deadpan captain of the Black Bulls.

SISTER_LILY.description: Gentle, sweet nun with a dangerous right fist.

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The sky tears open over the final battlefield.

visuals.query: anime still of the sky ripping open with red and black light over the final battlefield, Lucifero's power overhead

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Asta! Wake up! Asta!

visuals.query: Liebe screaming Asta's name, wide-eyed, manga panel or anime still of his panicked face

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Asta falls. The world goes silent.

visuals.query: Asta in black form falling through the sky, sword slipping from his hand, final battle

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Church bells. Cold sheets. Small, trembling hands.

visuals.query: tiny child hands clutching a blanket, Hage church bedroom, early morning light

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Same bed. Same church. Same ceiling.

visuals.query: the Hage church exterior at dawn, small stone chapel in the Forsaken Realm

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Asta was never supposed to have magic.

visuals.query: Asta standing empty-handed at the grimoire ceremony while the crowd laughs at him

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He was supposed to wait fifteen years in the dirt for a miracle.

visuals.query: young Asta alone on a Hage village road looking up at the sky, dust in the air
child Asta small before the giant demon skull and the First Wizard King statue above Hage

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: What if he remembered everything?

visuals.query: close-up of a child Asta's eyes turning hard and ancient, determined stare

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Spade raid. The betrayals.

visuals.query: the Spade Kingdom raid on the Royal Capital, Dark Triad above burning rooftops

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The brother trapped inside the wall of Hage's tower.

visuals.query: the filthy five-leaf grimoire lying in the grimoire tower, dark and glowing faintly

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: At six years old?

visuals.query: six-year-old Asta staring straight at the camera with a grown man's resolve

chapters.title: THE BOY WHO READ THE WIND

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The wind in Hage comes down off the demon skull. Nobody ever thinks about it twice.

visuals.query: the giant demon skull above Hage village with the First Wizard King statue, wind in the grass
Hage village rooftops and dirt road in soft daylight

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Asta thinks about nothing else. He stands at the church fence, eyes closed, and feels the air lean.

visuals.query: young Asta standing at the church fence with eyes shut, hair stirring in the wind

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Ki. The breath and the heartbeat of the world. A body with no magic can still learn to hear it.

visuals.query: young Asta concentrating, eyes closed, calm face, early training
grass bending in a breeze across the village fields

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The air shifts. Three seconds later, Yuno's gust slams the laundry line, and every sheet snaps.

visuals.query: young Yuno casting wind magic, a gust whipping laundry on the church line
young Asta opening his eyes and smiling slightly as sheets snap behind him

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: You looked at the sheets before my wind even moved.

visuals.query: young Yuno frowning at Asta, puzzled

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Lucky guess.

visuals.query: young Asta shrugging with an innocent face

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Yuno is six, and still a crybaby. Last time Asta mocked him for it. This time he hands him a handkerchief.

visuals.query: young Yuno crying with young Asta beside him in Hage, church yard
young Asta offering a cloth, gentle expression

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: I was not crying. It was the wind.

visuals.query: young Yuno rubbing his eyes, denying everything

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Of course it was.

visuals.query: young Asta with a flat knowing half-smile

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Why are you being nice to me? It is strange.

visuals.query: young Yuno wiping his tears, suspicious look at Asta

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Consider it an investment.

visuals.query: young Asta with a flat knowing half-smile

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: It confuses everyone. The loudest child in Hage has gone quiet, and he watches everything.

visuals.query: Father Orsi and Sister Lily watching the orphans in the church yard, puzzled
young Asta sitting apart on the church steps, watching

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then Sister Lily crosses the yard, and an old habit wakes up on its own.

visuals.query: Sister Lily walking across the church yard with a gentle smile

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Sister Lily. Marry me.

visuals.query: young Asta proposing to Sister Lily with hands clasped, comedic

beats.speaker: SISTER_LILY
beats.text: Oh, Asta. You know the rule.

visuals.query: Sister Lily smiling sweetly while raising a water-wrapped fist

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He feels her weight shift a heartbeat early. For the first time in history, Asta steps aside.

visuals.query: Sister Lily's water magic fist swinging forward in a rush of water
young Asta sidestepping neatly with a calm face

beats.speaker: FATHER_ORSI
beats.text: It missed. Lily's fist missed! That has never happened!

visuals.query: Father Orsi wide-eyed and sweating in shock, comedic panic

beats.speaker: SISTER_LILY
beats.text: Oh my. Asta, you are growing up so fast.

visuals.query: Sister Lily smiling sweetly with a faint dark aura

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: At seven, Asta asks Yuno for a blindfold. Then he asks him to throw everything he has.

visuals.query: young Asta tying a blindfold over his eyes while young Yuno watches skeptically

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Wind blades. Pebbles. A gust meant to knock him flat. He slips between them like smoke.

visuals.query: young Yuno hurling wind magic across a field, blades of air flying
blindfolded young Asta ducking and slipping past a gust of wind

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: How did you know?

visuals.query: young Yuno breathing hard, wide-eyed in disbelief

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Throw harder.

visuals.query: blindfolded young Asta waiting calmly, head tilted

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: You breathe in before you cast.

visuals.query: young Asta pulling off a blindfold, calm certain gaze

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Yuno goes very still. He is not used to being the one who is behind.

visuals.query: young Yuno's expression hardening with competitive fire

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Then I will learn not to. I will be Wizard King first.

visuals.query: young Yuno declaring his goal, wind lifting his hair

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Try it. I am still going to beat you there.

visuals.query: young Asta grinning with fist clenched, facing Yuno

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Season after season, he trains the only thing nobody can take from him.

visuals.query: young Asta training hard in a Hage field, sweat and swinging a heavy bar
seasons passing over Hage village fields

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And every night, he climbs to the roof and looks at the grimoire tower.

visuals.query: young Asta on a rooftop at night looking toward the distant grimoire tower
the grimoire tower against the night sky

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Because he knows what is sleeping in its wall. And he knows how long it has been waiting.

visuals.query: a cracked stone wall inside the grimoire tower, faint dark glow
the five-leaf grimoire, tattered and dark

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Age ten. Midnight. The grimoire tower is empty, and Asta knows which stone to press.

visuals.query: young Asta creeping through the dark grimoire tower interior at night
grimoire tower interior at night, shelves and stone

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He needs no lantern. He follows the draft, cold and thin, to a crack in the wall.

visuals.query: narrow crack in a stone wall in the grimoire tower with dust drifting

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Behind the cracked stone lies a filthy, tattered book. Five leaves. He has waited four years to touch it.

visuals.query: the filthy five-leaf grimoire lodged in the grimoire tower wall

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: His fingers close on the cover. The tower disappears.

visuals.query: the five-leaf grimoire's tattered cover, dark energy beginning to leak
black void swallowing the scene, the mindscape

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Black water. No floor. No sky. Something vast turns over in the dark, and it is hungry.

visuals.query: the black mindscape of the five-leaf grimoire, endless dark with red glow

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Chains of old black light hang from nowhere, and every one of them is aimed at him.

visuals.query: dark chains and anti-magic energy hanging in the black mindscape

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: A magicless brat. Walking right into my mouth. How convenient.

visuals.query: Liebe grinning with sharp teeth, menacing, glowing eyes in the mindscape

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Devils hate humans. I hate you most. I will be wearing you by morning.

visuals.query: Liebe lunging forward with claws raised in the dark mindscape

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Asta does not raise a hand. He does not reach for a weapon. He just looks up.

visuals.query: small figure of Asta standing calm before the huge devil in the black mindscape

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Why are you not afraid, boy?

visuals.query: Liebe leaning close, eyes narrowed, suspicious

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Your name is Liebe.

visuals.query: young Asta looking up with steady, gentle eyes
Liebe frozen, eyes widening in disbelief

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Who told you that? Nobody knows that.

visuals.query: Liebe's face twisted with suspicion and fear

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Your mother named you. Her name was Licita.

visuals.query: young Asta speaking softly, steady eyes
Licita smiling softly, holding baby Liebe, manga panel or flashback still

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Do not say that name.

visuals.query: Liebe baring his teeth, eyes wet, fury and grief

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Licita. She held you until the very end.

visuals.query: young Asta speaking gently with sorrowful eyes
Licita embracing Liebe in his flashback of her death

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: I said do not.

visuals.query: Liebe lunging with claws, rage at its peak

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The dark shudders. Claws that were closing stop, trembling, an inch from his face.

visuals.query: devil claws stopped inches from a child's face
anti-magic aura crackling and fading

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: She died. She sealed me in this filth and died. What do you know?

visuals.query: Liebe with his head bowed, claws shaking, grief

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: That she chose you. Every single time.

visuals.query: young Asta's calm and tearful face, quiet resolve

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Nothing. For a long time, only the sound of something enormous trying not to breathe.

visuals.query: the black mindscape gone still, drifting embers
Liebe lowering his head in silence

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: She was my mother too.

visuals.query: young Asta's eyes glistening, raw honesty

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: No. That is not possible.

visuals.query: Liebe's face crumbling, rage fading into shock

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: She left me at a church door so I would live.

visuals.query: baby Asta left at the church door in Hage, flashback

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Who are you?

visuals.query: Liebe asking quietly, defenses gone

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Your brother. And I am late.

visuals.query: young Asta offering a faint smile, eyes soft
Liebe stunned, mouth open

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Last time, I was fifteen years late.

visuals.query: young Asta's haunted eyes, years of grief

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Last time? What does that mean?

visuals.query: Liebe frowning, suspicious and confused

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Later. First, let me sit down.

visuals.query: young Asta sitting down in the dark mindscape, relaxed

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: What do you want from me?

visuals.query: Liebe watching Asta warily

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: To sit here for a minute. With my brother.

visuals.query: Asta and Liebe side by side in the dark mindscape, quiet

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: You are the stupidest human I have ever met.

visuals.query: Liebe turning his face away, rough grin hiding tears

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Probably. I have been told.

visuals.query: young Asta smiling warmly

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Outside, the dawn bell rolls over Hage. Asta climbs out of the tower with dust on his hands and no fear at all.

visuals.query: grimoire tower at dawn over Hage, soft light
Hage village waking at sunrise

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Behind him, in the wall, a devil lies still for the first time in years. Not trapped. Waiting.

visuals.query: the five-leaf grimoire in its wall, faint glow pulsing

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Five years. By day, Ki footwork in the fields until his legs shake and the wind tells him everything.

visuals.query: teen Asta running and dodging through a Hage field, training
teen Yuno casting wind nearby as Asta slips past

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: By night, he sits against the tower wall and talks. About bread. About Yuno. About the sky.

visuals.query: Asta sitting against the grimoire tower wall at night talking quietly
grimoire tower against a starry night sky

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Today Yuno tried to cut a tree. The tree won.

visuals.query: Asta sitting against the tower wall, chuckling in the dark

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: You are boring me to death, human.

visuals.query: Liebe rolling his eyes, bored smirk

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Then why do you answer?

visuals.query: Asta grinning with eyes closed against the stone wall

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: I am trapped. Echoes are all I get.

visuals.query: Liebe looking away, hiding embarrassment

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The book will not open before the ceremony. So Asta waits, again, and this time he is not waiting alone.

visuals.query: the five-leaf grimoire sealed in the tower wall, quiet
Asta at the church window at dusk, waiting

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Make the contract. Master and servant. That is how it works.

visuals.query: Liebe holding out a clawed hand offering a devil contract

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: No. Equals, or nothing.

visuals.query: Asta shaking his head with a firm, steady look

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Tch. Fine. As if I care.

visuals.query: Liebe turning away with an embarrassed scowl

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Fifteen. The tower hall is packed with trembling children. Yuno steps forward, and a four-leaf grimoire answers him.

visuals.query: Yuno receiving the four-leaf grimoire in the grimoire tower, golden light
the crowd in the tower hall gasping at the four-leaf grimoire

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Then it is Asta's turn. Nothing. No light, no book. Only laughter, rolling across the hall.

visuals.query: Asta standing with empty hands as the crowd laughs at him in the grimoire tower

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: They are laughing at you. Does that not bother you?

visuals.query: Liebe watching through the grimoire's dark, needling

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Not anymore. I know how this ends.

visuals.query: Asta with a quiet, assured look amid the crowd

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Exactly as before, down to the last giggle. And this time, Asta smiles.

visuals.query: Asta with a calm smile despite the laughter around him

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the road home, Revchi steps out of the trees, chains hissing at his wrists. He wants Yuno's grimoire.

visuals.query: Revchi the former Magic Knight stepping out with chain magic coiling
Yuno clutching the four-leaf grimoire on the road

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He does not notice the magicless boy already standing behind him.

visuals.query: Asta standing calmly behind Revchi on the road

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Revchi. Chain Magic. Thrown out of the Purple Orcas in disgrace.

visuals.query: Asta with a cold, steady stare

beats.speaker: REVCHI
beats.text: What? Magicless trash like you has no right to

visuals.query: Revchi sneering with a vicious grin

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Skip it.

visuals.query: Asta cutting him off with a flat unimpressed look

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Behind them the tower groans. A crack tears up the wall, and the stone gives way.

visuals.query: the grimoire tower cracking open, rubble falling

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The five-leaf grimoire rips itself free and tears across the sky, straight for his hand.

visuals.query: the five-leaf grimoire flying through the sky streaming dark light
Asta reaching out as the grimoire flies into his hand

beats.speaker: LIEBE
beats.text: Hurry up, partner. I am getting bored.

visuals.query: Liebe grinning wide, eager for a fight

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Demon-Slayer Sword drops into his hand. One swing.

visuals.query: Asta swinging the Demon-Slayer Sword, black anti-magic aura

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Revchi's chains do not break. They simply stop existing.

visuals.query: Revchi staring in shock as his chains vanish into nothing
the Demon-Slayer Sword blade, dark and still

beats.speaker: REVCHI
beats.text: My chains. What did you do to my chains?

visuals.query: Revchi trembling, staring at his empty hands

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: You have been hiding something since we were six.

visuals.query: Yuno with the four-leaf grimoire, studying Asta carefully

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Only a few things.

visuals.query: Asta shouldering the sword with a cheeky grin

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Fine. Keep them. Just leave me an enemy next time.

visuals.query: Yuno with a dry sidelong stare

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Then be faster.

visuals.query: Asta and Yuno facing each other, rivals smirking

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: I was letting you have it.

visuals.query: Yuno smirking at Asta, rivalry in the air

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The Royal Capital. Banners, towers, ten thousand voices. Every hopeful in the kingdom, packed into one arena.

visuals.query: the Royal Capital skyline, banners and towers in daylight
Magic Knights Entrance Exam arena packed with applicants

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And across the field, a man in black, cigarette burning low. Yami Sukehiro. Alive.

visuals.query: Yami Sukehiro standing in black with a cigarette, calm
Asta staring with wide eyes and trembling breath

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Asta's breath catches. He remembers how that man was taken. And now he is standing right there, yawning.

visuals.query: Asta fighting back emotion while looking at Yami across the arena

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: Kid. Why are you looking at me like I died?

visuals.query: Yami squinting with a deadpan unimpressed look

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: No reason.

visuals.query: Asta looking away, forced calm

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: Stop it. It is creepy.

visuals.query: Yami frowning, cigarette between his teeth

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Sorry. Long story.

visuals.query: Asta rubbing the back of his neck sheepishly

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: His match lasts one breath. Asta reads the swing, steps inside it, and ends it with one move.

visuals.query: Asta striking down an opponent with a single move in the arena
the stunned arena crowd falling silent

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: That was a good read, brat. Where did you learn it?

visuals.query: Yami eyeing Asta with sharp interest

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: A very patient teacher.

visuals.query: Asta holding back a smile

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: Tch. Whoever he is, he owes me a drink.

visuals.query: Yami smirking with a cigarette

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: The arena goes silent. Then one hand goes up. Then another. Hands that never went up before.

visuals.query: the captains raising their hands in the viewing box
captains' hands rising one after another over the arena

beats.speaker: YAMI
beats.text: Listen, brat. The Black Bulls are not exactly

visuals.query: Yami stepping forward to speak to Asta

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Black Bulls. Yes.

visuals.query: Asta answering instantly with a bright resolute grin

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Across the arena, Yuno signs with the Golden Dawn. Their eyes meet. Neither looks surprised.

visuals.query: Yuno choosing the Golden Dawn, calm and proud
Asta and Yuno looking at each other across the arena

beats.speaker: YUNO
beats.text: Do not fall behind.

visuals.query: Yuno calling across the arena with a faint smirk

beats.speaker: ASTA
beats.text: Do not trip.

visuals.query: Asta grinning back across the arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: On the arena floor, Asta closes his eyes. The captains' box becomes a map of heartbeats.

visuals.query: Asta closing his eyes to sense, calm focus
captains in the viewing box above the arena

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He knew where to look. William Vangeance sits very still. And inside him, two breaths. Two lives. One body.

visuals.query: William Vangeance with Patolli's presence behind his eyes
William Vangeance seated calmly among the captains

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: He files it away, like a coin saved for later.

visuals.query: Asta opening his eyes, a small calculating smile

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Above them all, Wizard King Julius Novachrono tilts his head. He is watching the boy.

visuals.query: Wizard King Julius Novachrono watching from his seat, tilting his head

beats.speaker: JULIUS
beats.text: Oh? This boy's time does not move like ours. Someone wound it back.

visuals.query: Julius with a bright, unsettling smile, Time Magic glowing

beats.speaker: JULIUS
beats.text: How interesting.

visuals.query: Julius's eyes glinting beneath his hat brim

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And Asta, for the first time, reaches out with Ki toward the Wizard King.

visuals.query: Asta looking up at the Wizard King's seat with trained senses

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: A heartbeat. Then, beside it, another. Two people in one man. And one of them has just turned to look at him.

visuals.query: Julius turning with a sudden unreadable stare
Asta's eyes wide in sudden realization

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: And that one knows Asta was never meant to be here.

visuals.query: Julius's shadowed face, an unsettling second presence
Asta frozen in the arena as the crowd cheers

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Part Two begins with a question he cannot answer. Who sent him back, and what are they waiting for?

visuals.query: Asta silhouetted against the night sky above the Royal Capital
the Royal Capital under a darkening sky

beats.speaker: NARRATOR
beats.text: Stay with us. The wind has already changed.

visuals.query: Asta's hair stirring in the wind, eyes forward
